rules.v: Recruiters must be licensed, and the law makes the agency liable jointly with the foreign employer for the worker's claims
rules.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin, dan hukum menjadikan agensi bertanggung jawab bersama majikan asing atas klaim pekerja
rules.n: Licensing by the Department of Migrant Workers; agencies are jointly and solidarily liable with the foreign employer for claims arising from the contract, and corporate officers are personally liable.
rules.s: RA 8042 sec. 10 as amended by RA 10022

rules.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
rules.v: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations

rules.n: The placement fee is capped at one month's salary; no fee may be charged to household service workers (since 2006), to seafarers, or where the destination prohibits charging workers.

rules.v: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
rules.n: Deployment requires a standard employment contract approved by the Department, verified by the Migrant Workers Office for direct and agency hires.

rules.v: Orientation on rights and complaint channels is compulsory and free of charge to the worker
rules.vi: Orientasi tentang hak dan saluran pengaduan wajib dan gratis bagi pekerja
rules.n: Pre-employment and pre-departure orientation seminars are compulsory; OWWA provides them free to most workers.

rules.v: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
rules.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.n: OWWA membership covers death, disability and repatriation and funds legal and welfare assistance; agency-hired workers also have compulsory insurance paid by the agency.

rules.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.v: A statute requires labor or welfare officers in missions in the main destination countries
rules.vi: Undang-undang mewajibkan atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di perwakilan negara tujuan utama
rules.n: Migrant Workers Offices with labor attachés and welfare officers are established by statute in destination countries.

rules.v: A specialized body at home can award compensation to workers against recruiters (and employers abroad) for breaches during recruitment or employment
rules.vi: Badan khusus di dalam negeri dapat memberi ganti rugi kepada pekerja terhadap perekrut (dan majikan asing) atas pelanggaran selama rekrutmen atau kerja
rules.n: Labor arbiters of the National Labor Relations Commission hear money claims of overseas workers against the agency and the employer jointly; the Department adjudicates recruitment violations.

rules.f: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
rules.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
rules.v: Restrictions by destination or occupation, or minimum ages above 18, that are sex-neutral on their face
rules.vi: Pembatasan menurut negara tujuan atau jabatan, atau usia minimum di atas 18, yang netral gender secara tertulis
rules.n: Deployment is allowed only to countries certified as protecting migrant workers, and bans or suspensions for named destinations have been used (for example Kuwait in 2018 and 2023). Household service workers must meet a minimum age set by rules (reported as 23 or 25; to be checked), sex-neutral on its face.
rules.s: RA 10022 sec. 3; DMW advisories; Governing Board Resolution (2006)

rules.v: A statute assigns a public body the duty to provide reintegration services (employment, financial, psychosocial) to returning workers
rules.vi: Undang-undang memberi badan publik kewajiban menyediakan layanan reintegrasi (kerja, keuangan, psikososial) bagi pekerja yang pulang
rules.n: The National Reintegration Center for OFWs, now within the Department of Migrant Workers, has a statutory mandate for reintegration services.

rules.f: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
rules.fi: Tempat penampungan bagi pekerja bermasalah di luar negeri
rules.v: A statute requires shelters or resource centers with temporary accommodation at missions in destination countries
rules.vi: Undang-undang mewajibkan tempat penampungan atau pusat layanan dengan akomodasi sementara di perwakilan negara tujuan
rules.n: Migrant Workers and Other Overseas Filipinos Resource Centers at missions provide counseling, legal services and temporary shelter.

rules.v: An official assistance line or crisis center for workers abroad operates 24 hours
rules.vi: Saluran bantuan atau crisis center resmi bagi pekerja di luar negeri beroperasi 24 jam
rules.n: The Department of Migrant Workers and OWWA operate a 24-hour operations center and hotlines.

rules.v: A statute provides or funds legal assistance for workers abroad, including in criminal and civil proceedings
rules.vi: Undang-undang menyediakan atau membiayai bantuan hukum bagi pekerja di luar negeri, termasuk dalam perkara pidana dan perdata
rules.n: A Legal Assistance Fund and a Legal Assistant for Migrant Workers' Affairs provide legal services to workers abroad.

rules.v: Statute contains specific duties on violence against women migrant workers (for example gender-responsive services or officers)
rules.vi: Undang-undang memuat kewajiban khusus tentang kekerasan terhadap perempuan pekerja migran (misalnya layanan atau petugas yang responsif gender)
rules.n: The law requires gender-sensitive programs and services for women migrant workers; the Magna Carta of Women adds duties for women overseas.

rules.fi: Kematian di luar negeri: pemulangan dan pemeriksaan
rules.v: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
rules.vi: Pemulangan dan santunan kematian diberikan, tanpa jalur untuk memastikan sebab kematian
rules.n: Repatriation of remains is at the agency's cost and OWWA pays death benefits; autopsies are available on the family's request through the National Bureau of Investigation, but no statutory inquiry procedure was found.

decisions.nm: Serrano v. Gallant Maritime Services
decisions.pe: A Filipino seafarer was sent home before his contract ended. The law limited what he could claim to three months’ pay. The Supreme Court said this limit treated overseas workers unfairly and struck it down, so he could claim pay for the rest of his contract.
decisions.pi: Seorang pelaut Filipina dipulangkan sebelum kontraknya berakhir. Undang-undang membatasi tuntutannya hanya tiga bulan gaji. Mahkamah Agung menyatakan batas itu tidak adil bagi pekerja luar negeri dan membatalkannya, sehingga ia bisa menuntut gaji sampai akhir kontrak.

decisions.nm: Sameer Overseas Placement Agency v. Cabiles
decisions.pe: A woman recruited in the Philippines for factory work in Taiwan was sent home early. The Supreme Court said the limit on her claim was still unfair, even though Congress had written it into the law again, and that the agency that recruited her must pay together with the employer.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan yang direkrut di Filipina untuk bekerja di pabrik di Taiwan dipulangkan lebih awal. MA menyatakan batas tuntutannya tetap tidak adil, walaupun Kongres sudah menuliskannya lagi dalam undang-undang, dan agen yang merekrutnya wajib membayar bersama majikan.

decisions.nm: Philippine Association of Service Exporters v. Drilon
decisions.pe: The Philippines stopped sending women abroad as domestic workers because of abuse. Recruitment agencies challenged the ban. The Supreme Court upheld it.
decisions.pi: Filipina menghentikan pengiriman perempuan sebagai pekerja rumah tangga karena banyak kekerasan. Agen perekrut menggugat larangan itu. MA mempertahankannya.

decisions.nm: JMM Promotion and Management v. Court of Appeals
decisions.pe: After a Filipina performer died in Japan, the government added training and a record book for performers going abroad. Agencies said this was unfair. The Supreme Court upheld the rule.
decisions.pi: Setelah seorang penghibur Filipina meninggal di Jepang, pemerintah menambah pelatihan dan buku catatan bagi penghibur yang ke luar negeri. Agen menyebutnya tidak adil. MA mempertahankan aturan itu.

decisions.nm: Becmen Service Exporter v. Cuaresma
decisions.pe: A young Filipina nurse died in Saudi Arabia and the employer called it suicide. Her parents sued. The Supreme Court held the recruitment agency and the employer liable to the family.
decisions.pi: Seorang perawat muda Filipina meninggal di Arab Saudi dan majikan menyebutnya bunuh diri. Orang tuanya menggugat. MA menyatakan agen dan majikan bertanggung jawab kepada keluarga.

decisions.nm: Datuman v. First Cosmopolitan Manpower
decisions.pe: A Filipina sent to Saudi Arabia was made to sign a new contract with worse pay and work. The Supreme Court said the agency in the Philippines must pay what she lost.
decisions.pi: Seorang perempuan Filipina yang dikirim ke Arab Saudi dipaksa menandatangani kontrak baru dengan upah dan pekerjaan lebih buruk. MA menyatakan agen di Filipina wajib membayar kerugiannya.

decisions.nm: Saudi Arabian Airlines v. Rebesencio
decisions.pe: A foreign airline forced Filipino cabin crew to resign when they became pregnant. The Supreme Court said they could sue at home and that their dismissal was unlawful.
decisions.pi: Sebuah maskapai asing memaksa awak kabin Filipina mengundurkan diri saat hamil. MA menyatakan mereka boleh menggugat di negaranya sendiri dan pemecatan itu tidak sah.

decisions.nm: Yap v. Thenamaris Ship’s Management
decisions.pe: A Filipino seafarer was let go early when his ship was sold. The Supreme Court applied its earlier Serrano ruling and said he must be paid for the rest of his contract.
decisions.pi: Seorang pelaut Filipina diberhentikan lebih awal ketika kapalnya dijual. MA menerapkan putusan Serrano dan menyatakan ia harus dibayar untuk sisa kontraknya.

decisions.nm: People v. Lalli
decisions.pe: Women from the Philippines were promised jobs in Malaysia but were forced into prostitution. The Supreme Court upheld the recruiters’ convictions.
decisions.pi: Perempuan dari Filipina dijanjikan pekerjaan di Malaysia tetapi dipaksa melacur. MA menguatkan vonis terhadap para perekrut.

decisions.nm: Sto. Tomas v. Salac
decisions.pe: Recruitment agencies argued it was unfair to make their directors personally pay workers’ claims. The Supreme Court said the rule is valid because it protects workers abroad.
decisions.pi: Agen perekrut berpendapat tidak adil membuat direkturnya membayar sendiri tuntutan pekerja. MA menyatakan aturan itu sah karena melindungi pekerja di luar negeri.

decisions.nm: PERT/CPM Manpower Exponent Co. v. Vinuya
decisions.pe: Filipino workers sent abroad were made to sign new contracts with lower pay than promised, then quit and came home. The Supreme Court said they had effectively been dismissed and the agency had to pay.
decisions.pi: Pekerja Filipina yang dikirim ke luar negeri dipaksa menandatangani kontrak baru dengan upah lebih rendah dari yang dijanjikan, lalu berhenti dan pulang. MA menyatakan mereka pada dasarnya dipecat dan agen harus membayar.

decisions.nm: Macalintal v. Commission on Elections (overseas absentee voting)
decisions.pe: A lawyer challenged the new law letting Filipinos abroad vote. The Supreme Court upheld the right of overseas workers to vote from abroad.
decisions.pi: Seorang advokat menggugat UU baru yang membolehkan warga Filipina di luar negeri memilih. MA mempertahankan hak pekerja di luar negeri untuk memilih dari luar negeri.

decisions.pi: Arti perekrutan: menawarkan kerja di luar negeri kepada satu orang pun bisa menjadi perekrutan ilegal.

decisions.nm: Ranises v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Seafarer's claim for unexpired contract salaries and salary differentials; NLRC reversal set aside in the worker's favour.
decisions.pi: Tuntutan pelaut atas gaji sisa masa kontrak dan selisih gaji; pembatalan oleh NLRC dikesampingkan dan pekerja dimenangkan.

decisions.nm: Stolt-Nielsen Marine Services v. NLRC (1996, G.R. 105396)
decisions.pe: Seafarer awarded unexpired contract salaries; fixed overtime of US$2,250 deleted for lack of proof of overtime work.
decisions.pi: Pelaut mendapat gaji untuk sisa masa kontrak; lembur tetap sebesar 2.250 dolar AS dihapus karena kerja lembur tidak terbukti.

decisions.nm: Pacific Maritime Services v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Seafarers' claims under POEA-approved contracts for unpaid salaries, fixed overtime and leave pay; NLRC award affirmed.
decisions.pi: Tuntutan pelaut berdasarkan kontrak yang disetujui POEA atas gaji yang belum dibayar, lembur tetap, dan uang cuti; putusan NLRC dikuatkan.

decisions.nm: EMS Manpower and Placement Services v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Worker in Hong Kong dismissed early; HK$55,000 salaries for unexpired contract affirmed against the agency.
decisions.pi: Pekerja di Hong Kong diberhentikan sebelum kontrak berakhir; gaji sisa masa kontrak sebesar 55.000 dolar Hong Kong dikuatkan terhadap agen.

decisions.nm: Philippine-Singapore Transport Services v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Dismissed worker's claim for unpaid salary, plane fare deducted from wages, leave pay and salaries for unexpired contract.
decisions.pi: Tuntutan pekerja yang dipecat atas gaji yang belum dibayar, ongkos pesawat yang dipotong dari upah, uang cuti, dan gaji sisa masa kontrak.

decisions.nm: Vinta Maritime v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Seafarer dismissed without due process; award of salaries including fixed overtime for the unexpired contract affirmed.
decisions.pi: Pelaut dipecat tanpa proses yang layak; putusan gaji termasuk lembur tetap untuk sisa masa kontrak dikuatkan.

decisions.nm: ABD Overseas Manpower v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Overseas worker's unexpired contract salaries and overtime claim; liability shared between two recruitment agencies.
decisions.pi: Tuntutan pekerja di luar negeri atas gaji sisa masa kontrak dan lembur; tanggung jawab dibagi antara dua agen perekrutan.

decisions.nm: Ocean East Agency v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Seafarer's salary, overtime, leave and benefits for unexpired contract; POEA award reinstated.
decisions.pi: Gaji, lembur, cuti, dan tunjangan pelaut untuk sisa masa kontrak; putusan POEA dipulihkan.

decisions.nm: Singa Ship Management v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Cruise ship worker's complaint for wages for unexpired contract and overtime pay; agency and principal held jointly liable.
decisions.pi: Pengaduan pekerja kapal pesiar atas upah sisa masa kontrak dan lembur; agen dan pemberi kerja di luar negeri bertanggung jawab bersama.

decisions.nm: ACCESS v. NLRC
decisions.pe: How to compute salaries owed for the unexpired portion of a Saudi contract (three months or full term).
decisions.pi: Cara menghitung gaji yang terutang untuk sisa masa kontrak di Arab Saudi (tiga bulan atau seluruh sisa masa kontrak).

decisions.nm: Triple Eight Integrated Services v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Woman food server in Saudi Arabia; unpaid salaries, salary differential and unexpired contract salaries after illness dismissal.
decisions.pi: Pramusaji perempuan di Arab Saudi; gaji yang belum dibayar, selisih gaji, dan gaji sisa masa kontrak setelah dipecat karena sakit.

decisions.nm: Asia World Recruitment v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Worker in Angola; salary differential, deductions from wages for vehicle damage and overtime pay claims.
decisions.pi: Pekerja di Angola; tuntutan selisih gaji, potongan upah untuk kerusakan kendaraan, dan uang lembur.

decisions.nm: Marsaman Manning Agency v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Seafarer repatriated early; salaries for the unexpired contract and attorney's fees affirmed.
decisions.pi: Pelaut dipulangkan sebelum kontrak berakhir; gaji sisa masa kontrak dan biaya pengacara dikuatkan.

decisions.nm: Barros v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Seafarer's claim for unexpired contract salaries, unauthorized deductions and discrimination for being Filipino; POEA decision reinstated.
decisions.pi: Tuntutan pelaut atas gaji sisa masa kontrak, potongan tanpa izin, dan diskriminasi karena berkebangsaan Filipina; putusan POEA dipulihkan.

decisions.nm: Sameer Overseas Placement Agency v. NLRC (1999)
decisions.pe: Domestic helper in Taiwan dismissed without cause; NT$151,996 salaries for unexpired contract affirmed.
decisions.pi: Pekerja rumah tangga di Taiwan dipecat tanpa alasan; gaji sisa masa kontrak sebesar 151.996 dolar Taiwan dikuatkan.

decisions.nm: Legahi v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Seafarer's claim for unexpired contract salary, unpaid overtime, leave pay and salary differential; award limited by the Court.
decisions.pi: Tuntutan pelaut atas gaji sisa masa kontrak, lembur yang tidak dibayar, uang cuti, dan selisih gaji; jumlah putusan dibatasi oleh Mahkamah.

decisions.nm: Skippers Pacific v. Mira
decisions.pe: Seafarer's complaint for illegal dismissal and unpaid salaries and allowances for the unexpired contract; award affirmed.
decisions.pi: Pengaduan pelaut atas pemecatan tidak sah serta gaji dan tunjangan yang belum dibayar untuk sisa masa kontrak; putusan dikuatkan.

decisions.nm: OSM Shipping Philippines v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Seafarer's unpaid salaries, accrued fixed overtime, allowance, leave pay and termination pay; NLRC award reinstated.
decisions.pi: Gaji pelaut yang belum dibayar, lembur tetap, tunjangan, uang cuti, dan pesangon; putusan NLRC dipulihkan.

decisions.nm: De Jesus v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Seafarer's unpaid wages applied to his repatriation cost; claim for unpaid wages, sickwage allowance and medical expenses upheld.
decisions.pi: Upah pelaut yang belum dibayar dipakai untuk biaya pemulangannya; tuntutan atas upah, tunjangan sakit, dan biaya pengobatan dikabulkan.

decisions.nm: EDI-Staffbuilders International v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Which law governs an overseas contract; salaries for the unexpired portion under Republic Act 8042.
decisions.pi: Hukum mana yang berlaku bagi kontrak kerja di luar negeri; gaji sisa masa kontrak berdasarkan Republic Act 8042.

decisions.nm: Talidano v. Falcon Maritime
decisions.pe: Seafarer alleging maltreatment of Filipino crew; dismissal declared illegal with salary award under RA 8042.
decisions.pi: Pelaut yang mengadukan perlakuan buruk terhadap awak kapal Filipina; pemecatan dinyatakan tidak sah dan gaji wajib dibayar berdasarkan RA 8042.

decisions.nm: Universal Staffing Services v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Worker in the UAE illegally dismissed; three months' salary under RA 8042 Section 10; overtime and holiday pay denied.
decisions.pi: Pekerja di Uni Emirat Arab dipecat secara tidak sah; tiga bulan gaji berdasarkan Pasal 10 RA 8042; uang lembur dan uang hari libur ditolak.

decisions.nm: Ventis Maritime v. Court of Appeals
decisions.pe: Ship officer's unpaid salary and accrued benefits and guaranteed overtime; Court of Appeals set aside.
decisions.pi: Gaji dan tunjangan perwira kapal yang belum dibayar serta lembur yang dijamin; putusan Pengadilan Banding dibatalkan.

decisions.nm: NFD International Manning Agents v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Crew repatriated early; unpaid wages and salaries for the unexpired portion with damages affirmed.
decisions.pi: Awak kapal dipulangkan sebelum kontrak berakhir; upah yang belum dibayar dan gaji sisa masa kontrak beserta ganti rugi dikuatkan.

decisions.nm: Hanjin Heavy Industries v. Court of Appeals
decisions.pe: Construction worker abroad awarded salaries for the entire unexpired portion of his contract.
decisions.pi: Pekerja konstruksi di luar negeri mendapat gaji untuk seluruh sisa masa kontraknya.

decisions.nm: Centro Project Manpower Services v. Naluis
decisions.pe: Dismissed worker gets placement fee refund and unexpired contract salaries; guaranteed overtime and holiday pay deleted.
decisions.pi: Pekerja yang dipecat mendapat pengembalian biaya penempatan dan gaji sisa masa kontrak; lembur dan uang hari libur yang dijamin dihapus.

decisions.nm: Eagle Clarc Shipping Philippines v. NLRC
decisions.pe: Seafarer's claim for unexpired contract salary, fixed overtime and benefits; award affirmed with changes.
decisions.pi: Tuntutan pelaut atas gaji sisa masa kontrak, lembur tetap, dan tunjangan; putusan dikuatkan dengan perubahan.

decisions.nm: Jerzon Manpower and Trading v. Nato
decisions.pe: Worker in Taiwan awarded three months' unpaid salaries under RA 8042 Section 10; financial assistance award changed.
decisions.pi: Pekerja di Taiwan mendapat tiga bulan gaji yang belum dibayar berdasarkan Pasal 10 RA 8042; putusan bantuan keuangan diubah.

help.city: Manila, bagi warga Filipina di luar negeri
help.de: 24-hour hotline for Filipino workers abroad and their families: repatriation, legal and welfare help. From abroad, dial +63 2 1348.
help.di: Saluran 24 jam bagi pekerja Filipina di luar negeri dan keluarganya: pemulangan, bantuan hukum dan kesejahteraan. Dari luar negeri, hubungi +63 2 1348.
